title: What can track spacing show?
hook: Tracks can preserve the space between steps.

knows: A distance can be divided into equal segments.
doesNotKnow: Compute spacing from a stated model and distinguish it from an estimated speed.

misconception: Track spacing by itself proves an exact speed or species.
objective: Compute spacing from a stated model and distinguish it from an estimated speed.

claims.text: Tracks can preserve the space between steps. In a toy example, two trackways span 6 metres. A has three equal gaps and B has six. Which has longer average spacing between adjacent prints? In the constructed example, A has three gaps across 6 metres, so each gap is 2 metres; B has six gaps, so each is 1 metre. Track spacing alone does not tell us an exact running speed or which species made the tracks.

claims.text: Recall: A toy trackway spans 8 metres with four equal gaps. What is each gap? Eight metres divided among four equal gaps gives two metres per gap.
